system.name: InstructScene
system.one_liner: Instruction-driven 3D indoor scene synthesis in two stages: a semantic graph prior designs a scene graph, then a layout decoder places the objects.

content.variant_note: three titled stages joined by two verb-labelled thick arrows, one real instruction followed through, with a codebook zoom underneath
content.argues: A semantic graph designed from the instruction, with object features and spatial relations, turns text into a coherent 3D scene when objects are then embodied from the graph.
content.subject: One bedroom instruction turned into a coloured object graph with relation-labelled edges and then into a decoded 3D scene; one node opened into codebook features.

elements.role: natural-language instruction naming four objects and their spatial relations
elements.drawn_as: wavy rounded frame beside a person icon; object phrases underlined in colours, left and above in bold italic

elements.name: Design

elements.name: Semantic Graph Prior

elements.name: front / above / left of / right of
elements.role: spatial relation carried by an edge
elements.drawn_as: small white rounded boxes with thin black outlines sitting on the edges

elements.name: gold node
elements.role: one object node, opened to show its semantic feature
elements.drawn_as: gold circle with a dark gold outline, source of a dashed gold wedge

elements.name: Object Feature Codebook
elements.role: discrete set of object feature entries the node features are taken from
elements.drawn_as: black-framed box with a 3 x 7 grid of colour swatches and an ellipsis

elements.name: zoom of one node
elements.role: shows the node's feature as a stack of four swatches beside the object image

elements.name: Embody
elements.role: stage 2: places objects in a scene by decoding 7-DoF attributes from the graph prior
elements.drawn_as: thick black arrow with a line-art robot arm above it and the verb below

elements.name: Decoded 3D Scene
elements.drawn_as: perspective render of a bed, wardrobe, nightstand and ceiling lamp inside thin white 3D boxes

encoding.color_means: node colour = object identity, repeated on its phrase in the instruction (grey nightstand rosy brown, wooden wardrobe gold, white ceiling lamp pale yellow, black double bed dark grey); gold also draws the zoom wedge and box; codebook swatches stand for feature entries
encoding.line_style_means: dashed gold wedge and box = zoom into one node; thin curved arrows = spatial relations between objects; thick black arrows = stage transitions; grey block arrow = lookup in the codebook
encoding.shape_means: circle = object node; small rounded white box on an edge = relation word; wavy rounded frame = the user's instruction; framed grid = codebook
encoding.marker_means: coloured underline = an object phrase; bold italic = a spatial relation word; the verb under a thick arrow names the stage
encoding.emphasis: The instruction's colour-coded phrases are tied to the graph nodes, and the single gold node is blown up by a dashed wedge, so the reader sees where each phrase ends up and what a node's feature is made of.
reusable_patterns: colour-coded underlined phrases in the instruction matched to graph node colours

new_tags.name: swatch-codebook
new_tags.what: a discrete codebook or vocabulary drawn as a framed grid of coloured swatches with an ellipsis, then zoomed to the few entries one item uses

lessons.what_to_learn: Thread one real instruction through every stage and keep one colour per object from the underlined phrase to the graph node, then open a single node with a dashed wedge into the features it is built from; a verb and a small icon on each thick arrow name the stages without extra boxes.
lessons.suits: Text-to-structure-to-output generators (scenes, layouts, molecules) where an instruction becomes an intermediate structure and then a rendered result.

evidence: INSTRUCTSCENE first designs a holistic semantic graph based on user instruction.
each node is an object endowed with semantic features and each edge represents a spatial relationship between objects

summary: InstructScene is a generative framework for instruction-driven 3D indoor scene synthesis, made of a semantic graph prior and a layout decoder. Figure 1 follows one bedroom instruction through the method. A person icon and a wavy bubble hold the instruction, where the phrases for the nightstand, wardrobe, ceiling lamp and bed are underlined in colours and the words left and above are bold italic. A thick arrow labelled Design, with a robot-head icon, leads to a graph whose coloured nodes match those phrases and whose curved edges carry relation words. A second arrow labelled Embody, with a robot-arm icon, leads to a decoded 3D bedroom render. Below, an Object Feature Codebook swatch grid is linked by a grey arrow to a dashed gold zoom of the wardrobe node.
summary_zh: InstructScene 由语义图先验和布局解码器组成，按文字指令合成 3D 室内场景。图以一句卧室指令为例：彩色下划线短语对应同色图节点，边标空间关系；Design 生成语义图，Embody 得到 3D 场景，下方虚线放大特征码本。
notes: The prior said panels=3; the three titled stages are not framed or separated, so I count one drawing with a pipeline of titled stages. The graph has two rosy-brown nodes while the instruction names one nightstand; the figure does not explain the second. The knowledge-graph tag is used for the drawn form (coloured nodes with relation-named edges), although this is a spatial scene graph.
